senses.en: Full of energy and eager to make things happen.
Continuously changing or developing.
A pattern of interaction between people or forces.

ex.en: Our dynamic coach keeps everyone moving throughout the session.
ex.zh: 我们精力充沛的教练让大家整节训练课都保持运动。

ex.en: A dynamic economy requires businesses to adapt quickly to technological advances and changing consumer preferences.
ex.zh: 充满活力的经济需要企业迅速适应技术进步和消费者偏好的变化。

tip: 形容人指有活力；形容系统指不断变化。

senses.en: An action continuing or checking earlier work or treatment.
Done after something to continue it or check its results.

ex.en: The clinic arranged a follow-up to check my recovery.
ex.zh: 诊所安排了一次复诊，以检查我的恢复情况。

ex.en: A follow-up study is needed to determine whether the training programme produces lasting improvements in employment outcomes.
ex.zh: 需要开展后续研究，以确定该培训项目是否能持续改善就业结果。

tip: 名词、形容词带连字符；动词短语follow up不带。

senses.en: working for yourself rather than for an employer

ex.en: Self-employment lets me choose when I take holidays.
ex.zh: 自雇让我可以自己决定什么时候休假。

ex.en: Although self-employment offers greater flexibility, it can also involve irregular income and limited access to employment benefits.
ex.zh: 虽然自雇更灵活，但也可能意味着收入不稳定，且难以享有雇员福利。

tip: 不可数；指为自己工作，不一定是创办公司。

senses.en: Beside someone or something, or together with them.
In a position beside someone or something.

ex.en: I cycled alongside my sister by the river.
ex.zh: 我沿着河边骑车，与姐姐并排而行。

ex.en: Schools should teach practical skills alongside academic subjects to prepare students for adult life.
ex.zh: 学校应在教授学术课程的同时传授实用技能，帮助学生为成年生活做好准备。

col: alongside other measures｜与其他措施同时
tip: 作介词后接名词；也可表示两件事同时进行。

senses.en: A particular type of material with specific physical properties.
The central meaning or most important content of something.
Meaningful content or a solid basis for belief.

ex.en: A sticky substance had leaked onto the kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 一种黏糊糊的物质漏到了厨房地板上。

ex.en: Factories must prevent harmful substances from entering rivers, as contaminated water threatens both wildlife and human health.
ex.zh: 工厂必须防止有害物质进入河流，因为受污染的水会威胁野生动物和人类健康。

tip: 表示物质种类时可数；表示实质或根据时通常不可数。

senses.en: Having good luck or experiencing a favourable outcome

ex.en: We were fortunate to find shelter before the storm.
ex.zh: 我们很幸运，在暴风雨来临前找到了避雨处。

ex.en: Students with reliable internet access are fortunate, as many rural communities still lack adequate digital infrastructure.
ex.zh: 能稳定上网的学生是幸运的，因为许多农村社区仍缺乏完善的数字基础设施。

col: fortunate enough to｜足够幸运能够
tip: 常用 be fortunate to do，表示有幸做某事。

senses.en: causing or likely to cause damage or injury

ex.en: Too much direct sunlight can be harmful to your skin.
ex.zh: 过多的阳光直射会伤害你的皮肤。

ex.en: Stricter controls on industrial waste could reduce the harmful effects of water pollution on local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 加强对工业废物的管控，可以减少水污染对当地生态系统的有害影响。

tip: 表示对……有害用harmful to，不用harmful for。

senses.en: a natural substance found in rocks, soil, food, or water
relating to minerals found in the earth

ex.en: The museum displayed a mineral with bright purple crystals.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了一块带有亮紫色晶体的矿物。

ex.en: Countries with abundant mineral resources need effective regulations to limit the environmental damage caused by mining.
ex.zh: 矿产资源丰富的国家需要有效的法规，以限制采矿造成的环境破坏。

tip: 营养语境中minerals指矿物质，不等于维生素。

senses.en: Only for the stated reason or in the stated way.

ex.en: I bought this little camera purely for fun.
ex.zh: 我买这台小相机纯粹是为了好玩。

ex.en: University education should not be judged purely by graduates' salaries, as it also brings wider social benefits.
ex.zh: 不应仅凭毕业生的薪资评价大学教育，因为它还带来更广泛的社会效益。

col: purely for pleasure｜纯粹为了乐趣
tip: 常放在for、by或形容词前，强调不含其他因素。

senses.en: the importance of something, especially its effects
the special meaning that something carries or suggests

ex.en: I finally understood the significance of her quiet smile.
ex.zh: 我终于明白了她那淡淡微笑中的含义。

ex.en: The discovery has considerable significance for scientists seeking cleaner and more affordable sources of energy.
ex.zh: 这一发现对寻找更清洁、更经济能源的科学家具有重要意义。

col: the significance of｜……的重要性或含义
tip: be of great significance相当于be very significant。

senses.en: The readiness to do something without needing to be forced.

ex.en: Her willingness to help made the move much easier.
ex.zh: 她乐意帮忙，让这次搬家轻松了许多。

ex.en: Students' willingness to ask questions often increases when teachers create a supportive classroom environment.
ex.zh: 教师营造支持性的课堂环境时，学生提问的意愿往往会增强。

col: a willingness to cooperate｜合作的意愿
tip: 不可数名词，常接to do表示做某事的意愿。

senses.en: a trained worker who operates, maintains, or repairs technical equipment

ex.en: The technician replaced a broken part in our washing machine.
ex.zh: 技师更换了我们洗衣机里一个损坏的零件。

ex.en: Laboratory technicians play an essential role in medical research by preparing samples and maintaining specialist equipment.
ex.zh: 实验室技术员通过准备样本和维护专业设备，在医学研究中发挥重要作用。

tip: technician 侧重设备操作维护，不等同于 engineer。

senses.en: to own or have something
to have a particular quality, ability, or characteristic

ex.en: My uncle possesses a remarkable collection of antique clocks.
ex.zh: 我叔叔拥有一批令人惊叹的古董钟藏品。

ex.en: Graduates who possess strong communication skills are often better prepared to adapt to changing workplace demands.
ex.zh: 具备较强沟通能力的毕业生通常更能适应不断变化的职场要求。

tip: 比have正式；通常不用进行时。注意拼写有四个s。

senses.en: beans grown for their protein, or food made from them
a salty brown sauce made from fermented beans

ex.en: I usually pour soy milk over my breakfast cereal.
ex.zh: 我通常把豆奶倒在早餐麦片上。

ex.en: Soy provides plant protein, but expanding its cultivation can threaten forests when land is cleared irresponsibly.
ex.zh: 大豆提供植物蛋白，但若不负责任地开垦土地，扩大种植可能威胁森林。

tip: 英式英语也常用soya；“酱油”通常说soy sauce。

senses.en: To become smaller, weaker, or less successful.
A reduction in amount, strength, quality, or importance.
To politely refuse an offer, invitation, or request.

ex.en: I thanked her for dinner but declined the invitation.
ex.zh: 我感谢她邀我吃饭，但婉拒了邀请。

ex.en: As public transport improves, private car use may decline, reducing congestion and air pollution in urban areas.
ex.zh: 随着公共交通改善，私家车使用量可能下降，从而缓解城市拥堵和空气污染。

col: a decline in sales｜销售额下降
tip: 下降用decline in；婉拒做某事用decline to do。

senses.en: A small hole made by a sharp object, especially in tyres.
Make a small hole in something with a sharp object.

ex.en: A puncture in my bicycle tyre made me late.
ex.zh: 我的自行车轮胎被扎破了，害得我迟到了。

ex.en: Sharp debris on poorly maintained cycle lanes can puncture tyres and discourage residents from cycling to work.
ex.zh: 维护不善的自行车道上的尖锐碎屑可能扎破轮胎，使居民不愿骑车上班。

col: repair a puncture｜修补轮胎刺孔
tip: 英式英语说get a puncture；美式常说get a flat。

senses.en: unable to see, hear, or respond because awareness is lost
done without awareness, or unaware of something

ex.en: The unconscious patient was breathing steadily beneath a blanket.
ex.zh: 失去知觉的病人盖着毯子，呼吸平稳。

ex.en: Unconscious bias can influence recruitment decisions, even when employers aim to treat all applicants fairly.
ex.zh: 即使雇主力求公平对待所有求职者，无意识的偏见仍可能影响招聘决定。

tip: unconscious of表示未察觉；昏迷不是普通睡眠。

senses.en: in a way that cannot be prevented or avoided

ex.en: Without regular watering, these flowers will inevitably die.
ex.zh: 如果不定期浇水，这些花必然会枯死。

ex.en: A growing population will inevitably increase demand for housing unless household sizes change significantly.
ex.zh: 除非家庭规模发生显著变化，否则人口增长必然会增加住房需求。

tip: 语气比probably强，表示结果无法避免。

senses.en: A tool with a broad blade for moving loose material.
To lift or move material using a shovel.

ex.en: I used a shovel to clear the snowy path.
ex.zh: 我用铲子清除了小路上的积雪。

ex.en: Community volunteers shovelled soil into raised beds to create a garden on unused urban land.
ex.zh: 社区志愿者把土铲进高架种植床，在闲置的城市土地上建起花园。

tip: 英式过去式为shovelled，美式为shoveled。

senses.en: not knowing about a particular fact or subject
lacking knowledge, education, or understanding

ex.en: I was ignorant of the rules until someone explained them.
ex.zh: 直到有人解释，我才了解这些规则。

ex.en: Consumers who remain ignorant of online privacy risks may share sensitive information without considering the consequences.
ex.zh: 不了解网络隐私风险的消费者，可能会在未考虑后果的情况下分享敏感信息。

col: ignorant of the facts｜不了解事实
tip: 常用be ignorant of；直接形容人可能带贬义。

senses.en: Someone you know, but who is not a close friend.
Some knowledge of a person or subject.

ex.en: An acquaintance from my yoga class waved at me.
ex.zh: 瑜伽课上认识的一位熟人向我挥了挥手。

ex.en: Even a basic acquaintance with local customs can help international students adapt more easily to life abroad.
ex.zh: 即使只是对当地习俗略有了解，也能帮助国际学生更轻松地适应海外生活。

tip: 指熟人时可数；表示了解时常接with。

senses.en: Easy to see or understand.
Seeming to be true, though possibly not actually true.

ex.en: Her excitement was apparent from her huge smile.
ex.zh: 从她灿烂的笑容中可以明显看出她很兴奋。

ex.en: Despite the apparent benefits of remote learning, some students struggle without direct support from teachers.
ex.zh: 尽管远程学习看似有诸多好处，一些学生在缺乏教师直接帮助时仍感到吃力。

col: for no apparent reason｜无明显原因
tip: 可指“明显的”，也可指“看似的”，须看语境。

senses.en: Annoyance caused by being unable to achieve what you want.

ex.en: She sighed in frustration when the printer jammed again.
ex.zh: 打印机又卡纸了，她懊恼地叹了口气。

ex.en: Repeated delays in public transport can increase commuters' frustration and reduce their confidence in local services.
ex.zh: 公共交通反复延误会加剧通勤者的挫败感，降低他们对当地服务的信心。

col: growing frustration｜日益加深的挫败感
tip: 人感到frustrated；令人受挫的事物是frustrating。

senses.en: a familiar short saying expressing advice or a general truth

ex.en: My grandmother often quotes a proverb about being patient.
ex.zh: 我祖母经常引用一句劝人耐心的谚语。

ex.en: A traditional proverb can reveal the values that a community passes down through successive generations.
ex.zh: 传统谚语可以揭示一个群体代代相传的价值观。

tip: proverb是流传的完整俗谚；idiom多为固定习语。

senses.en: A change from one state, stage, or situation to another.
To change from one state or situation to another.

ex.en: A familiar toy eased her transition to nursery.
ex.zh: 一个熟悉的玩具帮助她适应了托儿所生活。

ex.en: The transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy requires sustained investment and careful government planning.
ex.zh: 从化石燃料向可再生能源的转型需要持续投资和政府的周密规划。

col: transition from A to B｜从甲到乙的转变
tip: 常用transition from A to B表示两种状态间转变。

senses.en: A boat used for pleasure trips or racing.

ex.en: We watched a white yacht sail across the bay.
ex.zh: 我们看着一艘白色帆船驶过海湾。

ex.en: The growing popularity of yacht tourism can generate income for coastal communities but may damage marine habitats.
ex.zh: 游艇旅游日益流行，能为沿海社区创造收入，但也可能破坏海洋栖息地。

tip: ch不发音；通常指休闲或竞赛用船。

senses.en: a light inside a protective container, often with a handle

ex.en: He carried a lantern along the dark garden path.
ex.zh: 他提着一盏灯，沿着漆黑的花园小径走去。

ex.en: Solar lanterns provide affordable lighting in remote communities where reliable access to electricity remains limited.
ex.zh: 在仍难以稳定用电的偏远社区，太阳能灯提供了价格实惠的照明。

tip: 指有外罩的灯，常可提携；不等同于手电筒。

senses.en: According to available information, though not necessarily certain.

ex.en: Apparently, the bakery closes early on rainy days.
ex.zh: 听说那家面包店下雨天会提早关门。

ex.en: Apparently, many residents support the proposed park, although a formal survey has not yet been conducted.
ex.zh: 看来许多居民支持拟建公园的计划，但正式调查尚未开展。

tip: 表示据现有信息推测，不保证事实确实如此。

senses.en: A small raised spot on the skin, often red.

ex.en: A small pimple appeared on my chin overnight.
ex.zh: 一夜之间，我的下巴上冒出了一颗小痘痘。

ex.en: Teenagers who develop pimples may benefit from gentle skincare rather than frequent washing with harsh soap.
ex.zh: 长痘痘的青少年采用温和的护肤方式，可能比频繁使用刺激性肥皂洗脸更有益。

col: a pimple on your chin｜下巴上的痘痘
tip: pimple指单颗痘痘；acne指痤疮这种皮肤问题。

senses.en: To suffer or die from insufficient food
To deny someone or something an essential resource

ex.en: Without regular feeding, these rescued animals could starve.
ex.zh: 如果不定期喂食，这些获救的动物可能会饿死。

ex.en: When drought destroys crops, rural families may starve unless emergency food supplies reach them quickly.
ex.zh: 当干旱毁坏庄稼时，如果紧急食品不能及时送达，农村家庭可能会挨饿。

col: be starved of resources｜严重缺乏资源
tip: 日常说I'm starving表示饿极了，并非濒临饿死。

senses.en: a feeling of wanting something that someone else has
to wish you had another person's possessions, qualities, or advantages
a person or thing that others wish to equal or possess

ex.en: I envy your ability to sleep on noisy trains.
ex.zh: 我真羡慕你能在嘈杂的火车上睡着。

ex.en: Social media can encourage envy by exposing users to carefully selected images of other people's achievements and lifestyles.
ex.zh: 社交媒体让用户接触他人精心挑选的成就和生活方式图片，可能引发羡慕或嫉妒。

col: envy someone something｜羡慕某人拥有某物
the envy of｜令……羡慕的人或事物
tip: 动词直接接宾语：envy someone，不加of。

senses.en: Something accepted as true without definite proof.
The act of taking on responsibility, power, or a role.

ex.en: My assumption that the shop opened early was wrong.
ex.zh: 我以为这家店很早开门，结果想错了。

ex.en: The assumption that all young people possess advanced digital skills may lead to inadequate support in schools.
ex.zh: 认为所有年轻人都具备高级数字技能的假设，可能导致学校提供的支持不足。

tip: 常用assumption that从句，表示未经证实的看法。

senses.en: a serious situation requiring urgent decisions or action

ex.en: The broken water pipe caused a crisis at home.
ex.zh: 水管破裂让家里陷入了困境。

ex.en: The housing crisis has forced many young adults to delay moving into their own homes.
ex.zh: 住房危机迫使许多年轻人推迟搬进自己的住所。

col: in times of crisis｜在危机时期
tip: 复数为crises /ˈkraɪsiːz/，注意词尾发音。

senses.en: a design or symbol that represents an organisation or product

ex.en: The bakery uses a wheat stalk as its logo.
ex.zh: 这家面包店用一支麦穗作为徽标。

ex.en: A distinctive logo helps consumers recognise a company, but product quality is essential for building lasting trust.
ex.zh: 独特的徽标帮助消费者识别企业，但产品质量才是建立持久信任的关键。

tip: logo指视觉标识；slogan指宣传口号。

senses.en: To produce flowers.
A flower, or the state of producing flowers.
To develop successfully or become more confident and attractive.

ex.en: The roses bloom beside our kitchen window every summer.
ex.zh: 每年夏天，玫瑰都在我们的厨房窗边盛开。

ex.en: Urban gardens that bloom throughout spring and summer provide valuable food sources for bees and other pollinators.
ex.zh: 春夏持续开花的城市花园为蜜蜂及其他传粉动物提供了宝贵的食物来源。

tip: bloom可作动词；表示正在开花用in bloom。

senses.zh: 座位间过道；货架间通道
senses.en: a passage between rows of seats or shelves

ex.en: Please keep your bag out of the aisle.
ex.zh: 请不要把包放在过道上。

ex.en: Wider supermarket aisles can improve accessibility for wheelchair users and make shopping more comfortable for everyone.
ex.zh: 更宽的超市通道能方便轮椅使用者通行，也能让所有人购物时更加舒适。

col: walk down the aisle｜沿过道走；结婚
tip: s不发音，与isle同音；aisle seat是靠过道座位。

senses.en: a family member who lived several generations before you
an earlier species or form from which something developed

ex.en: One of my ancestors built this old stone house.
ex.zh: 我的一位祖先建造了这座古老的石屋。

ex.en: Studying how our ancestors adapted to environmental change can offer insights into human resilience.
ex.zh: 研究祖先如何适应环境变化，可以帮助我们理解人类的适应能力。

tip: ancestor指祖先；descendant指后代。

senses.en: Wanting exclusive control over someone or something.
Showing who owns something or how things are related.

ex.en: My little brother is possessive about his toy trains.
ex.zh: 我弟弟对他的玩具火车占有欲很强。

ex.en: Possessive behaviour in friendships can limit personal freedom and make it difficult to maintain healthy relationships.
ex.zh: 友谊中的占有行为会限制个人自由，使健康关系难以维持。

tip: 对物占有欲强常用about；语法中指所属关系。

senses.en: Eager and willing to work towards a goal.
Driven by a particular reason or purpose.

ex.en: I feel more motivated after exercising in the morning.
ex.zh: 早晨运动之后，我感觉更有干劲。

ex.en: Students are more likely to remain motivated when teachers provide constructive feedback and achievable goals.
ex.zh: 当教师提供建设性反馈和可实现的目标时，学生更有可能保持学习动力。

col: motivated by profit｜受利润驱动的
tip: motivated to do表示有动力做；by引出动机。

senses.en: A noticeable smell, especially an unpleasant one.

ex.en: A strange odour came from the kitchen bin.
ex.zh: 厨房垃圾桶里飘出一股怪味。

ex.en: Residents may oppose new waste facilities if they expect unpleasant odours to affect their quality of life.
ex.zh: 如果居民预计难闻的气味会影响生活质量，他们可能会反对新建垃圾处理设施。

tip: 英式拼写odour，美式odor；常指难闻气味。

senses.en: To become softer or make something softer
To make something less harsh, severe, or forceful

ex.en: Leave the butter outside the fridge to soften.
ex.zh: 把黄油放在冰箱外，让它变软。

ex.en: Additional financial support could soften the impact of rising energy prices on poorer households.
ex.zh: 额外的经济援助可以减轻能源价格上涨对较贫困家庭的影响。

tip: 既可及物也可不及物：热使黄油变软，黄油也会自行变软。

senses.en: An important discovery or advance that overcomes a difficult problem.

ex.en: After weeks of practice, I finally made a breakthrough.
ex.zh: 练习了几周后，我终于取得了突破。

ex.en: A breakthrough in battery technology could make renewable energy more reliable and affordable for households.
ex.zh: 电池技术的突破可能使可再生能源对家庭而言更加可靠、更加经济。

col: breakthrough in treatment｜治疗方面的突破
tip: 名词写成一个词；动词短语break through分开写。

senses.en: An accepted way of behaving or doing something.
A large meeting of people with shared interests or work.
A formal agreement between countries about a particular issue.

ex.en: By convention, guests wait until everyone is seated before eating.
ex.zh: 按照惯例，客人等所有人落座后才开始用餐。

ex.en: An international convention can strengthen environmental protection by establishing shared responsibilities for participating countries.
ex.zh: 国际公约可以通过确立参与国的共同责任来加强环境保护。

tip: 惯例与大会通常可数；by convention意为按惯例。

senses.en: official permission for something to happen
a positive opinion of someone or something

ex.en: We need the landlord's approval before painting the kitchen.
ex.zh: 粉刷厨房前，我们需要得到房东的许可。

ex.en: New housing projects should receive approval only when developers demonstrate that adequate transport and public services will be provided.
ex.zh: 开发商只有证明能提供充足的交通和公共服务，新住宅项目才应获批。

tip: approval of常指赞同；approval for常指项目许可。

senses.en: Special or unusual enough to be remembered for a long time.

ex.en: That snowy train journey was a truly memorable experience.
ex.zh: 那次雪中火车之旅真是一次难忘的经历。

ex.en: Practical experiments often make science lessons more memorable by connecting abstract ideas with direct experience.
ex.zh: 实际操作的实验将抽象概念与亲身体验联系起来，往往使科学课更令人难忘。

tip: memorable形容事物难忘，不表示某人记忆力好。

senses.en: to make something less heavy or less demanding
to become or make something brighter or paler
to make a mood or atmosphere more cheerful

ex.en: I removed two books to lighten my backpack.
ex.zh: 我拿出了两本书，让背包轻一些。

ex.en: Employers can lighten staff workloads by simplifying administrative procedures and providing better tools for routine tasks.
ex.zh: 雇主可以通过简化行政流程、为日常任务提供更好的工具来减轻员工的工作负担。

tip: lighten可指减负或变亮；lighten up常指放轻松。

senses.en: to cause someone to believe something incorrect

ex.en: The photograph misled me about the apartment's actual size.
ex.zh: 那张照片让我误判了公寓的实际大小。

ex.en: Advertisements can mislead consumers into believing that expensive products always offer better quality than cheaper alternatives.
ex.zh: 广告可能误导消费者，使他们相信昂贵产品的质量总比便宜的替代品更好。

col: mislead someone into believing｜误导某人相信
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为misled；常接into doing。

senses.en: Causing worry or fear that something bad may happen.

ex.en: The engine made an alarming noise as we climbed.
ex.zh: 我们上坡时，发动机发出了令人不安的声音。

ex.en: The alarming decline in insect populations could threaten food production and disrupt entire ecosystems.
ex.zh: 昆虫数量令人担忧的下降可能威胁粮食生产，并扰乱整个生态系统。

col: an alarming increase｜令人担忧的增长
an alarming trend｜令人担忧的趋势
tip: alarming形容事物令人担忧；alarmed形容人感到惊恐。

senses.en: Located on the outside of something.
Coming from outside a particular organisation, system, or situation.

ex.en: The builders painted the external walls pale yellow.
ex.zh: 建筑工人把外墙刷成了淡黄色。

ex.en: Universities often rely on external funding to conduct research that cannot be supported by tuition fees alone.
ex.zh: 大学经常依赖外部资金，开展仅靠学费无法支持的研究。

col: for external use only｜仅供外用
tip: external与internal相对；药品上指外用的。

senses.en: To express approval or admiration for someone or something.
Words expressing approval or admiration.

ex.en: Our coach praised us for helping the new players.
ex.zh: 教练表扬了我们帮助新队员的举动。

ex.en: Teachers who praise effort rather than natural ability may encourage students to persist when facing academic challenges.
ex.zh: 表扬努力而非天赋的教师，可能更能鼓励学生在学业遇到挑战时坚持下去。

col: praise someone for something｜因某事表扬某人
tip: praise sb for sth；名词通常不可数。

senses.en: Medical treatment involving cutting into the body to repair damage.
A place where a doctor or dentist sees patients.

ex.en: My uncle is recovering well after knee surgery.
ex.zh: 我叔叔做完膝关节手术后恢复得很好。

ex.en: Advances in medical technology have made many types of surgery safer and reduced patients' recovery times.
ex.zh: 医疗技术的进步提高了多种手术的安全性，并缩短了患者的康复时间。

tip: 手术义通常不可数；英式英语中诊所义可数。

senses.en: towards the south
moving or pointing towards the south

ex.en: We drove southward until we reached the coast.
ex.zh: 我们一直向南开车，直到抵达海岸。

ex.en: The southward movement of some marine species may reflect changes in ocean temperatures and food availability.
ex.zh: 一些海洋物种向南迁移，可能反映了海水温度和食物供应的变化。

tip: southward兼作形容词和副词；southwards仅作副词。

senses.en: A curved structure spanning an opening or supporting weight
To bend into a curved shape

ex.en: We sheltered from the rain beneath a stone arch.
ex.zh: 我们在一座石拱门下避雨。

ex.en: Traditional bridges often use a central arch to distribute weight and allow boats to pass beneath.
ex.zh: 传统桥梁常用中央拱形结构来分散重量，并让船只从下方通过。

tip: 作动词表示弯成拱形，如arch your back。

senses.en: a possible effect or consequence of an action or decision
an idea suggested without being stated directly
involvement in something wrong or illegal

ex.en: We discussed the financial implications of buying a puppy.
ex.zh: 我们讨论了买小狗可能带来的经济负担。

ex.en: Policymakers must consider the long-term implications of automation for employment, education, and social equality.
ex.zh: 政策制定者必须考虑自动化对就业、教育和社会平等的长期影响。

col: implications for employment｜对就业的潜在影响
tip: 表示潜在影响常用复数 implications，后接 for。

senses.en: Three times as much, or consisting of three parts.
To become three times as much, or make something so.

ex.en: The hotel charges triple the price during holidays.
ex.zh: 这家酒店在假日期间收取平时三倍的价格。

ex.en: Demand for renewable energy could triple as governments introduce stricter limits on carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 随着各国政府对碳排放实施更严格的限制，可再生能源需求可能增至三倍。

col: triple in size｜规模增至三倍
tip: triple表示变为原来的三倍，即增加两倍。

senses.en: relating to genes or characteristics passed from parents to offspring

ex.en: The doctor explained how genetic factors affect eye colour.
ex.zh: 医生解释了遗传因素如何影响眼睛的颜色。

ex.en: Genetic research may help doctors identify health risks before patients develop any noticeable symptoms.
ex.zh: 基因研究可能帮助医生在患者出现明显症状之前识别健康风险。

tip: genetic指基因或遗传的；genetics是遗传学。

senses.en: a very large flightless bird with long legs and neck

ex.en: The ostrich ran quickly across the dusty grassland.
ex.zh: 那只鸵鸟飞快地跑过尘土飞扬的草原。

ex.en: Although the ostrich cannot fly, its powerful legs allow it to escape many predators in open habitats.
ex.zh: 虽然鸵鸟不会飞，但它强壮的双腿使它能在开阔的栖息地逃脱许多捕食者。

tip: 复数为ostriches；“埋头沙中逃避”并非真实习性。

senses.en: the process of obtaining and using food for health
the study of how food affects health and growth

ex.en: Good nutrition helps children grow and stay active.
ex.zh: 良好的营养有助于儿童成长并保持活力。

ex.en: Schools should teach nutrition so that young people can make informed choices about their daily diets.
ex.zh: 学校应教授营养知识，让年轻人能够在了解相关信息的基础上选择日常饮食。

tip: nutrition不可数；nutrient指具体的营养物质。

senses.en: the process of bringing something new into existence
something new that someone has made or designed

ex.en: The creation of our garden took several busy weekends.
ex.zh: 我们忙了好几个周末才建好花园。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy can support job creation while helping countries reduce their dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源可以促进就业，同时帮助各国减少对化石燃料的依赖。

col: the creation of wealth｜财富的创造
tip: 指创造过程通常不可数；指具体作品时可数。

senses.en: to gradually break down through natural processes
the natural process of rotting or breaking down
a gradual loss of strength, quality, or importance

ex.en: Fallen leaves decay slowly beneath the trees each winter.
ex.zh: 每到冬天，落叶都会在树下慢慢腐烂。

ex.en: Urban decay often accelerates when public infrastructure is neglected and businesses move away from residential neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 当公共基础设施缺乏维护、企业迁离居民区时，城市衰败往往会加速。

tip: 名词通常不可数；tooth decay指龋齿，不是掉牙。

senses.en: work needed to keep something in good condition
the act of keeping a condition or situation unchanged
money paid regularly to support a child or former spouse

ex.en: Regular maintenance keeps my old bicycle safe to ride.
ex.zh: 定期保养让我的旧自行车骑起来依然安全。

ex.en: Governments should budget for the long-term maintenance of public infrastructure rather than focusing solely on new construction.
ex.zh: 政府应为公共基础设施的长期维护安排预算，而不应只关注新建工程。

col: the maintenance of standards｜标准的维持
tip: 通常不可数；拼写不是maintainance。

senses.en: A warm-blooded animal whose females produce milk for their young.

ex.en: A dolphin is a mammal, even though it lives underwater.
ex.zh: 海豚虽然生活在水下，却是哺乳动物。

ex.en: Protecting marine mammals requires international cooperation because these animals often migrate across the waters of several countries.
ex.zh: 保护海洋哺乳动物需要国际合作，因为这些动物经常跨越多个国家的水域迁徙。

tip: 鲸和海豚也是哺乳动物；不能按栖息地判断。

senses.en: Connected with inner feelings and meaning rather than material things.
Related to religious beliefs or experiences.

ex.en: Walking quietly in the forest gives me spiritual comfort.
ex.zh: 在森林里静静散步能给我心灵上的慰藉。

ex.en: Public spaces can support spiritual well-being by offering residents peaceful places for reflection and connection with nature.
ex.zh: 公共空间可以为居民提供安静思考和亲近自然的场所，从而促进精神健康。

tip: 可指心灵层面，不一定涉及宗教。

senses.en: Happening or produced every three months.
Once every three months.
A magazine published every three months.

ex.en: Our club holds quarterly meetings at the local library.
ex.zh: 我们俱乐部每季度在当地的图书馆开一次会。

ex.en: Quarterly reports allow investors to monitor company performance and identify emerging financial risks throughout the year.
ex.zh: 季度报告让投资者能够全年跟踪公司的表现，并识别新出现的财务风险。

tip: quarterly指每三个月一次，不是每四个月一次。

senses.en: to fill or use a space, place, or period
to take and maintain control of a place by force
to keep someone busy or interested

ex.en: These old boxes occupy most of our spare room.
ex.zh: 这些旧箱子占了我们闲置房间的大部分空间。

ex.en: Private cars occupy valuable urban space that could otherwise accommodate parks, cycle lanes, or wider pavements.
ex.zh: 私家车占用了宝贵的城市空间，而这些空间本可用于建设公园、自行车道或更宽的人行道。

tip: 忙于某事可用be occupied with或in doing。

senses.en: A small, smooth stone, often found near water.

ex.en: A smooth grey pebble lay beside my wet shoes.
ex.zh: 我的湿鞋旁躺着一颗光滑的灰色卵石。

ex.en: Removing pebbles from beaches can disturb coastal habitats and reduce natural protection against erosion.
ex.zh: 从海滩上移走卵石可能扰乱沿海栖息地，并削弱抵御侵蚀的天然屏障。

tip: pebble强调小而光滑；stone泛指石头。

senses.en: An area of ground used for outdoor team sports.
How high or low a sound is.
Present an idea or product to persuade someone to accept it.

ex.en: The players ran onto the pitch despite the rain.
ex.zh: 尽管下着雨，球员们还是跑进了球场。

ex.en: Young entrepreneurs often pitch their business ideas to investors who can provide funding and practical guidance.
ex.zh: 年轻创业者经常向能够提供资金和实用指导的投资者推介商业构想。

tip: 球场义常见于英式英语；pitch a tent意为搭帐篷。

senses.en: very small in amount or as little as possible

ex.en: These plants need minimal care, even during hot weather.
ex.zh: 这些植物即使在炎热天气里也只需极少的照料。

ex.en: Well-designed buildings can maintain comfortable indoor temperatures with minimal energy use, reducing both costs and emissions.
ex.zh: 设计良好的建筑能以极低的能耗保持舒适的室内温度，同时降低成本和排放。

tip: minimal 指极少或最低限度，不一定表示完全没有。

senses.en: The act of vanishing or becoming impossible to find.
The process of gradually ceasing to exist.

ex.en: The disappearance of my keys made me late again.
ex.zh: 我的钥匙不见了，害得我又迟到了。

ex.en: The gradual disappearance of traditional crafts reflects changing lifestyles and declining demand for handmade goods.
ex.zh: 传统手工艺逐渐消亡，反映出生活方式的变化以及手工制品需求的下降。

tip: 常接of说明消失的人或物；动词为disappear。

senses.en: someone who makes pots and other objects from clay
to spend time doing small tasks without hurrying

ex.en: The potter shaped a bowl with her wet hands.
ex.zh: 陶工用湿润的双手捏出了一个碗。

ex.en: Local potters can preserve traditional skills while attracting visitors interested in the region's cultural heritage.
ex.zh: 当地陶工既能保护传统技艺，也能吸引对该地区文化遗产感兴趣的游客。

col: potter about the garden｜在花园里悠闲地忙活
tip: 作动词常用potter about/around，表示悠闲忙活。

senses.en: Connected rooms used together, especially in a hotel
A set of software programs or furniture used together
A musical work consisting of several related pieces

ex.en: Our hotel suite has a balcony overlooking the sea.
ex.zh: 我们住的酒店套房有一个面朝大海的阳台。

ex.en: The university provides a software suite that enables students to analyse data and prepare research presentations.
ex.zh: 该大学提供一套软件，帮助学生分析数据并制作研究报告演示文稿。

tip: 读音同sweet；suit意为西装，读音不同。

senses.en: unable to distinguish some colours from others

ex.en: My color-blind uncle sometimes confuses red apples with green ones.
ex.zh: 我叔叔有色盲，有时分不清红苹果和青苹果。

ex.en: Designers should use distinct shapes alongside colours to make public information accessible to color-blind users.
ex.zh: 设计师应在使用颜色的同时采用不同形状，让色盲用户也能获取公共信息。

tip: 英式通常拼作colour-blind；不一定完全看不见颜色。

senses.en: A university division covering a particular group of subjects.
The teaching staff of a university, college, or school.
A natural mental or physical ability.

ex.en: The science faculty has moved into a new building.
ex.zh: 理学院已搬进一栋新楼。

ex.en: Cooperation between the faculty of engineering and local industries can help students develop skills relevant to employment.
ex.zh: 工程学院与当地产业的合作可以帮助学生培养与就业相关的技能。

tip: 英式常指大学院系，美式常指全体教员。

senses.en: to become ripe or make fruit or crops ripe

ex.en: Leave these green tomatoes on the windowsill to ripen.
ex.zh: 把这些青番茄放在窗台上，让它们慢慢成熟。

ex.en: Warmer temperatures can cause fruit to ripen earlier, forcing farmers to adjust their harvesting schedules.
ex.zh: 气温升高会使水果提早成熟，迫使农民调整采收时间。

col: ripen on the vine｜在藤上成熟
ripen in the sun｜在阳光下成熟
tip: ripe是形容词；ripen是动词，可及物也可不及物。

senses.en: To gather closely together or curl up for warmth or protection.
A group of people standing or sitting close together.
A brief close gathering to discuss something privately.

ex.en: We huddled under one umbrella until the rain stopped.
ex.zh: 我们挤在同一把伞下，直到雨停。

ex.en: Without adequate shelter, displaced families may huddle together outdoors, increasing their exposure to cold and illness.
ex.zh: 缺乏足够住所时，流离失所的家庭可能只好在户外挤作一团，更容易受寒和生病。

col: huddle for warmth｜挤在一起取暖
huddle around a fire｜围着火堆挤在一起
tip: huddle强调紧靠，常为取暖、避险或私下商议。

senses.en: to provide what a particular person or group needs
to supply food and drinks for an event

ex.en: These weekend classes cater for children of all ages.
ex.zh: 这些周末课程面向各个年龄段的儿童。

ex.en: Public transport systems should cater for passengers with limited mobility by providing accessible vehicles and stations.
ex.zh: 公共交通系统应提供无障碍车辆和车站，满足行动不便乘客的需求。

col: cater for different needs｜满足不同需求
cater to individual tastes｜迎合个人喜好
cater for a wedding｜为婚礼提供餐饮
tip: cater for指满足需求或供餐；cater to常指迎合。

senses.en: someone or something not included in a general rule or pattern
an objection, especially in the phrase take exception to

ex.en: Everyone enjoyed the soup, with the exception of my brother.
ex.zh: 除了我哥哥，大家都很喜欢这道汤。

ex.en: Although public transport is generally affordable, rural communities often represent an exception because services are limited.
ex.zh: 虽然公共交通通常价格低廉，但农村社区往往是例外，因为可用的服务有限。

col: an exception to the rule｜规则的例外
tip: 规则的例外用exception to，不用exception of。

senses.en: The outline of a face or object seen from the side.
A short description of someone's life, work, or characteristics.
The amount of public attention someone or something receives.

ex.en: She drew her grandfather's profile with a soft pencil.
ex.zh: 她用软铅笔画出了祖父的侧面轮廓。

ex.en: Public exhibitions can raise the profile of local artists and attract visitors to smaller towns.
ex.zh: 公共展览能提高当地艺术家的知名度，并吸引游客前往小城镇。

col: raise the profile of｜提高……的知名度
keep a low profile｜保持低调
tip: in profile指呈侧面；a high profile指高关注度。

senses.en: Unusual and interesting, especially because of a connection with distant countries.
Originating outside the region where something is now found.

ex.en: The market sells exotic fruits I have never tasted.
ex.zh: 市场里卖着我从未尝过的异国水果。

ex.en: Introducing exotic plants into local gardens can threaten native species if their spread is not controlled.
ex.zh: 将外来植物引入当地花园后，若不控制其蔓延，可能会威胁本土物种。

col: exotic destination｜富有异国情调的目的地
tip: 生态语境中指非本土的，不一定具有入侵性。

senses.en: To gradually wear away soil or rock through natural forces.
To gradually reduce strength, value, or confidence.

ex.en: Strong waves have eroded the cliffs near our village.
ex.zh: 强劲的海浪侵蚀了我们村庄附近的悬崖。

ex.en: Persistent inflation can erode household savings, making it harder for families to afford essential goods.
ex.zh: 持续的通货膨胀会削弱家庭储蓄的购买力，使家庭更难负担生活必需品。

col: erode public trust｜削弱公众信任
tip: 可指自然侵蚀，也可指信任、价值等逐渐受损。

senses.en: someone who makes or alters clothes, especially suits
to make or adapt something for particular needs

ex.en: The tailor shortened my trousers while I waited nearby.
ex.zh: 我在旁边等着，裁缝把我的裤子改短了。

ex.en: Teachers should tailor their lessons to students' abilities rather than follow a single approach for everyone.
ex.zh: 教师应根据学生的能力调整课程，而不是对所有人采用同一种方法。

col: tailor something to individual needs｜按个人需求调整
tip: tailor A to B表示“根据B调整或定制A”。

senses.en: Nervous and unable to relax, or stretched tightly.
A verb form that indicates time.
To tighten muscles or become physically stiff.

ex.en: She looked tense while waiting outside the interview room.
ex.zh: 她在面试室外等候时显得很紧张。

ex.en: A tense working environment can reduce productivity and discourage employees from sharing creative ideas.
ex.zh: 紧张的工作环境可能降低生产效率，并使员工不愿分享创新想法。

tip: 作名词指语法“时态”；作形容词指紧张或绷紧。

senses.en: an organized society with developed institutions, culture, and technology
the comforts and services associated with modern society

ex.en: We explored the ruins of an ancient civilization yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们探访了一处古代文明的遗址。

ex.en: Reliable water supplies played a crucial role in the development of civilization by supporting agriculture and permanent settlements.
ex.zh: 可靠的水源支持了农业和固定聚落的发展，在文明形成过程中发挥了关键作用。

col: the rise of civilization｜文明的兴起
tip: 英式也拼作 civilisation；某个文明可用 a civilization。

senses.en: Careful thought about something before making a decision.
Care for other people's feelings, needs, or comfort.
Something important to think about when making a decision.

ex.en: After careful consideration, we chose the smaller flat.
ex.zh: 经过仔细考虑，我们选择了那套较小的公寓。

ex.en: Urban planners should take the needs of older residents into consideration when designing public transport systems.
ex.zh: 城市规划者在设计公共交通系统时，应考虑老年居民的需求。

tip: 表考虑或体谅通常不可数；表考虑因素时可数。

senses.en: A machine for lifting and moving heavy objects.
A large bird with long legs and a long neck.
To stretch your neck to see something better.

ex.en: A crane lifted the heavy beam above the roof.
ex.zh: 一台起重机把沉重的横梁吊到了屋顶上方。

ex.en: Construction companies use cranes to assemble tall buildings efficiently, but strict safety procedures remain essential.
ex.zh: 建筑公司利用起重机高效建造高层建筑，但严格的安全规程仍然必不可少。

tip: 动词常用crane your neck，表示伸长脖子看。

senses.en: a process of investigating facts or seeking knowledge
a request for information about something

ex.en: My inquiry about the missing parcel received a quick reply.
ex.zh: 我询问了丢失包裹的情况，很快就收到了回复。

ex.en: An independent inquiry into river pollution revealed serious weaknesses in the current system of environmental monitoring.
ex.zh: 一项针对河流污染的独立调查揭示了现行环境监测体系的严重缺陷。

tip: 调查某事用inquiry into；英式enquiry也常指咨询。

senses.en: a hole in a lock into which a key fits

ex.en: I struggled to find the keyhole in the dark.
ex.zh: 黑暗中，我费了好大劲才找到钥匙孔。

ex.en: Modern electronic locks remove the need for a traditional keyhole, although they may create new security risks.
ex.zh: 现代电子锁不再需要传统的钥匙孔，不过也可能带来新的安全风险。

col: put a key in the keyhole｜把钥匙插入锁孔
look through the keyhole｜透过钥匙孔看
tip: keyhole surgery指小切口手术，不是钥匙孔手术。

senses.en: To join together or bring people together for a shared purpose.

ex.en: The whole village united to repair the damaged bridge.
ex.zh: 全村人团结起来修复受损的桥。

ex.en: Shared environmental goals can unite communities that otherwise have very different economic and political interests.
ex.zh: 共同的环境目标能让经济和政治利益原本大不相同的社区团结起来。

col: unite behind a leader｜团结支持一位领袖
tip: unite可及物也可不及物，强调为共同目标联合。

senses.en: a system through which users or devices interact
a boundary or connection between two things
connect and work together with another system or group

ex.en: The app's simple interface makes booking tickets much easier.
ex.zh: 这款应用的简洁界面让订票方便多了。

ex.en: An accessible user interface enables people with limited technical experience to benefit from digital public services.
ex.zh: 易于使用的用户界面能让技术经验有限的人也享受到数字公共服务。

tip: 计算机语境常指界面；作动词常接with。

senses.en: An official office representing a country in another country.

ex.en: I contacted the embassy after losing my passport abroad.
ex.zh: 在国外丢失护照后，我联系了大使馆。

ex.en: An embassy provides assistance to citizens overseas and helps maintain diplomatic relations between the two countries.
ex.zh: 大使馆为海外公民提供援助，并帮助维持两国间的外交关系。

tip: embassy指大使馆；consulate指领事馆。

senses.en: the period before something happens, especially in 'in the meantime'
during the time before another event happens

ex.en: Dinner is cooking; in the meantime, let's set the table.
ex.zh: 饭还在做，我们趁这会儿摆好餐具吧。

ex.en: The new railway will take years to complete; in the meantime, cities should improve existing bus services.
ex.zh: 新铁路还需要数年才能建成；在此期间，城市应改善现有公交服务。

col: meantime, continue working｜其间继续工作
tip: 最常用in the meantime；meanwhile可直接作副词。

senses.zh: 蹑手蹑脚地走；缓慢移动
senses.en: to move slowly and quietly, often to avoid being noticed
to spread or change slowly and almost unnoticed

ex.en: I crept upstairs to avoid waking the sleeping baby.
ex.zh: 我蹑手蹑脚地上楼，以免吵醒熟睡的宝宝。

ex.en: Housing costs can creep up gradually, placing increasing financial pressure on families with limited incomes.
ex.zh: 住房成本可能逐渐上涨，给收入有限的家庭带来越来越大的经济压力。

col: give someone the creeps｜使某人毛骨悚然
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为crept；不一定指爬行。

senses.en: The desire and energy that make you want to act.
A reason for doing something or behaving in a particular way.

ex.en: Training with a friend gives me motivation to keep running.
ex.zh: 和朋友一起训练让我有动力坚持跑步。

ex.en: Giving students meaningful choices can increase their motivation and encourage them to take responsibility for learning.
ex.zh: 给予学生有意义的选择，可以提高他们的积极性，并鼓励他们对学习负责。

col: motivation behind a decision｜决定背后的动机
tip: 动力常不可数；具体动机可数，常接for或behind。

senses.en: care taken to avoid danger or mistakes
a warning about danger or unacceptable behaviour
to warn someone about a risk or problem

ex.en: We walked with caution across the wet kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 我们小心地走过湿漉漉的厨房地板。

ex.en: Researchers caution that small studies may not provide reliable evidence for major changes in public health policy.
ex.zh: 研究人员提醒，小规模研究可能无法为公共卫生政策的重大调整提供可靠证据。

tip: caution against doing表示告诫不要做某事。

senses.en: having no colour
lacking interesting or distinctive qualities

ex.en: The bottle contained a colorless liquid that looked like water.
ex.zh: 瓶子里装着一种看起来像水的无色液体。

ex.en: Some harmful gases are colorless, making reliable detection equipment essential for maintaining safety in industrial workplaces.
ex.zh: 某些有害气体是无色的，因此可靠的检测设备对保障工业场所安全至关重要。

tip: 美式拼写；英式为colourless。无色不等于透明。

senses.en: great emotional pain, worry, or unhappiness
a situation involving danger or serious difficulty
to cause someone great worry or unhappiness

ex.en: Her neighbour noticed her distress and offered to help.
ex.zh: 邻居看出她很难过，便主动提出帮忙。

ex.en: Sudden unemployment can cause considerable distress, particularly for households with limited savings and high housing costs.
ex.zh: 突然失业会引发严重的焦虑，对储蓄有限且住房开支高的家庭尤其如此。

tip: distress比一般sadness强烈，也可指危难。

senses.en: Violent public disorder involving a crowd of people.
To behave violently as part of a crowd in public.

ex.en: The shop closed early because a riot broke out nearby.
ex.zh: 附近发生了骚乱，这家店提前关门了。

ex.en: Effective communication between communities and local authorities may help prevent peaceful demonstrations from turning into riots.
ex.zh: 社区与地方政府之间的有效沟通可能有助于防止和平示威演变为暴乱。

col: a riot breaks out｜骚乱爆发
tip: riot涉及暴力骚乱，不等于和平的protest。

senses.en: Suggest an idea or plan for others to consider.
Ask someone to marry you.
Intend or plan to do something.

ex.en: I proposed sharing a taxi to save us money.
ex.zh: 我提议合乘一辆出租车，给大家省点钱。

ex.en: Researchers propose expanding urban green spaces to improve air quality and encourage residents to exercise more regularly.
ex.zh: 研究人员提议扩大城市绿地，以改善空气质量并鼓励居民更经常地锻炼。

col: propose a solution｜提出解决方案
tip: propose doing是提议；propose to do通常是打算。

senses.en: To force saliva or something else out of your mouth.
The liquid produced naturally inside your mouth.

ex.en: He spat the bitter seed into a tissue.
ex.zh: 他把那颗苦涩的种子吐进了纸巾里。

ex.en: Public health campaigns discourage people from spitting in shared spaces because this behaviour can contribute to disease transmission.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传劝阻人们在公共场所吐痰，因为这种行为可能传播疾病。

col: spit into a tissue｜吐进纸巾
tip: 过去式和过去分词英式常用spat，美式也用spit。

senses.en: The size or extent of something
A measurement system or ratio representing relative size
One of the small hard plates covering a fish or reptile

ex.en: I hadn't realised the scale of your vegetable garden.
ex.zh: 我之前没意识到你的菜园有这么大。

ex.en: The scale of plastic pollution demands coordinated action from governments, manufacturers, and consumers worldwide.
ex.zh: 塑料污染的规模要求世界各地的政府、制造商和消费者协调行动。

col: on a large scale｜大规模地
the scale of the problem｜问题的严重程度
tip: 表示规模用on a large scale；表示秤通常用复数scales。
